mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing phenytoin metabolism and increasing phenytoin levels; conversely, phenytoin induces CYP3A4, reducing clarithromycin effectiveness.
action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely; consider alternative antibiotic; if used together, assess for phenytoin toxicity signs (ataxia, nystagmus, confusion) and adjust phenytoin dosing accordingly.
